title: Marcus Theatres Records Highest June Revenue of All Time
summary: Tremendous success of Toy Story 5 and strong performances from multiple exciting films drove June records at Marcus Theatres Marcus Theatres® , the nation’s fourth largest theatre circuit and a division of Marcus Corporation (NYSE: MCS), announced today that it recorded the highest total revenue for June in company history. These record results were driven by sustained excitement among Marcus Theatres’ moviegoers for the record-breaking debut of Toy Story 5 , a well-rounded slate of June releases including Scary Movie and Disclosure Day , and continued strong carryover performances from films like Obsession and Backrooms . Records broken during June include: The highest total revenue ever in the month of June. Highest concession, merchandise, and food and beverage revenue ever in the month of June. Record admission revenue per person for the month of June. Record concession, merchandise, and food and beverage revenue per person for the month of June. The highest box office since 2019
